info.description: REST API for meal planning, ingredients, and shopping lists.
info.title: MealPlanner API

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user's account and all associated data

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns JWT tokens
Uses a refresh token to get a new access+refresh token pair

get.description: Returns all ingredients for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by name

post.description: Creates a new ingredient for the authenticated user

get.description: Returns a single ingredient by ID (own only)

put.description: Replaces an ingredient by ID (own only)

delete.description: Deletes an ingredient by ID (own only)

get.description: Returns all meal plans for the authenticated user ordered by start date descending

post.description: Creates a new meal plan with optional entries for the authenticated user

get.description: Returns a meal plan with its entries (including meal names) - own only

put.description: Replaces a meal plan and its entries by ID (own only)

delete.description: Deletes a meal plan and its entries by ID (own only)

get.description: Returns an aggregated shopping list for a meal plan, grouped by category (own only)

parameters.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to plan start)
parameters.name: from_date

parameters.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to plan end)
parameters.name: to_date

post.description: Generates and persists a shopping list for a meal plan. shared=true combines partner's plan ingredients.

get.description: Returns all meals for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by type

post.description: Creates a new meal with ingredients for the authenticated user

get.description: Returns a single meal with ingredients by ID (own only)

put.description: Replaces a meal and its ingredients by ID (own only)

delete.description: Deletes a meal and its ingredients by ID (own only)

get.description: Returns the current partner's info or 404

delete.description: Removes partner link from both users and deletes shared shopping lists

post.description: Links two users as partners using an invite code
Generates a random invite code for partner linking

get.description: Returns a persisted shopping list with items and checked status

patch.description: Sets checked status on a shopping list item
